# Phase One — Theoretical File and Dependency Graph

The Awtsmoos is one, yet vessels divide so every purpose can be seen;
Awtsmoos.com should share the deepest engines while each app stays focused, small, and clean.

This is a theoretical graph, not authorization to edit these paths. Exact source files will be chosen only after current imports/exports and concurrent changes are re-read.

## Shared movie core — preferred new namespace
`libs/awtsmoos-procedural-core/src/core/movie/`

Potential small modules:
- `MovieDocument.js` — normalized top-level identity, duration, metadata, aspect ratio, frame rate.
- `MovieValidationError.js` — path, code, reason, repair hint.
- `MovieValidator.js` — structural validation and capability checks.
- `MovieScene.js` — normalized scene contract.
- `MovieSceneClock.js` — global time to scene/local time resolution.
- `MovieTimeline.js` — deterministic ordered scene spans and overlap/transition semantics.
- `MovieKeyframe.js` — canonical keyframe shape.
- `MovieInterpolator.js` — interpolation and easing delegation.
- `MovieTransition.js` — scene transition contract.
- `MovieCameraCue.js` — angle/movement/focus intent.
- `MovieLayer.js` — engine-neutral layer contract.
- `MovieActor.js` — reusable actor/character reference.
- `MovieAssetIntent.js` — portable generator/import descriptor.
- `MovieCapabilityCatalog.js` — machine-readable vocabulary for AI and apps.
- `MovieCompiler.js` — validated input to normalized executable timeline artifact.
- `MoviePatch.js` — safe JSON-like declarative patch contract, never arbitrary code.
- `MovieFeatureInventory.js` — proof/testing inventory.
- `index.js` — public movie namespace only.

Potential adapter subfolders if evidence supports them:
- `adapters/canvas2d/` — shape/text/chart/particle realization.
- `adapters/three/` — 3D object/camera/light/particle realization through existing Three/procedural systems.
- `adapters/assets/` — bridge movie asset intents into existing procedural core asset generators.
- `adapters/media/` — generic media clip descriptors without importing app-specific NLE implementation into core.

## Existing procedural systems to depend on, not duplicate
- `core/animation/` for skeletons, mixers, keyframes, shape keys, speech.
- `core/components/human/` and related character systems for people.
- `core/proceduralObject/assets/` for asset generator registry and recipes.
- `core/proceduralObject/particles/` for particle systems.
- `core/text/` for text geometry/bitmap capabilities where appropriate.
- `core/geometry/` and `core/proceduralObject/geometry/` for geometry generation.
- `core/webgl/camera/` for camera math where compatible.
- `core/reality/json/` for established JSON validation/facade patterns.
- `core/assets/` for asset resolution/cache patterns.

## Shared Awtsmoos UI — theoretical new library
Preferred path if no canonical equivalent is discovered:
`libs/awtsmoos-ui/`

Potential modules:
- `src/schema/UiRecipe.js` — canonical recipe shape.
- `src/schema/UiNode.js` — one UI node contract.
- `src/schema/UiValidationError.js` — JSON-path errors.
- `src/core/UiNormalizer.js` — strict defaults and normalization.
- `src/core/UiActionRegistry.js` — named actions and guarded dispatch.
- `src/core/UiStateReader.js` — controlled state bindings.
- `src/dom/UiElementFactory.js` — safe element creation.
- `src/dom/UiAttributePolicy.js` — permitted attributes/dataset/ARIA.
- `src/dom/UiDomRenderer.js` — recursive renderer.
- `src/dom/UiRepeater.js` — keyed collections.
- `src/dom/UiConditional.js` — visibility/branch nodes.
- `src/mobile/UiResponsivePolicy.js` — compact/mobile presentation hints.
- `src/studio/StudioShellRecipe.js` — reusable studio shell vocabulary.
- `src/studio/StudioWorkspaceRecipe.js` — preview/timeline/inspector layouts.
- `src/tokens/studioTokens.js` — dimensions and semantic token names.
- `src/index.js` — public UI API.
- `README.md` — grammar, examples, security model.

If discovery finds an existing canonical JSON/DOM system in `libs/awtsmoos`, these responsibilities should extend that existing home instead of spawning duplicate architecture.

## Flagship app — entirely new if still absent at source-write time
`apps/awtsmoos-studio/`

Potential modules:
- `index.html` — tiny shell and module entry.
- `main.js` — boot only.
- `modules/app/bootAwtsmoosStudio.js` — composition root.
- `modules/state/StudioMovieSession.js` — canonical movie session state.
- `modules/state/StudioSelection.js` — scene/layer selection.
- `modules/ai/StudioAiMovieBridge.js` — prompt/spec import/validation/repair surface.
- `modules/movie/StudioMovieLoader.js` — manifest/scenes load.
- `modules/movie/StudioMoviePlayback.js` — timeline play/seek.
- `modules/movie/StudioMoviePreview.js` — adapter selection and render scheduling.
- `modules/movie/StudioMovieExport.js` — delegates to verified export provider.
- `modules/ui/studioRecipe.js` — JSON UI recipe.
- `modules/ui/studioActions.js` — action registry.
- `modules/ui/studioViewModel.js` — data for UI recipe.
- `styles/tokens.css`, `styles/base.css`, `styles/studio.css`, `styles/mobile.css` only if shared UI does not supply equivalent structure.

## Three-minute proof structure
Prefer split data under:
`apps/awtsmoos-studio/examples/three-minute-revelation/`

- `manifest.js` or `.json` — metadata and ordered scene imports/references.
- `scenes/01-opening.js`
- `scenes/02-world.js`
- `scenes/03-characters.js`
- `scenes/04-tutorial.js`
- `scenes/05-infographic.js`
- `scenes/06-data-rise.js`
- `scenes/07-dialogue.js`
- `scenes/08-procedural-world.js`
- `scenes/09-particles.js`
- `scenes/10-climax.js`
- `scenes/11-recap.js`
- `scenes/12-credits.js`

Each scene should remain a readable, non-minified small module. Total timeline must equal exactly 180 seconds.

## Thin existing-app integrations — only if current live code lacks them
Possible NEW bridge files that avoid rewriting contested app cores:
- `apps/animator/js/movie/AwtsmoosMovieAdapter.js`
- `apps/video-editor/js/AwtsmoosMovieAdapter.js`
- `apps/mitzvah-studio/modules/bridge/AwtsmoosMovieBridge.js`
- `apps/nesher-studio/modules/movie/AwtsmoosMovieBridge.js`

Only add them if there is a real entry/integration path that can consume them. A bridge no app imports is not integration.

## Dependency graph
`AI prompt/spec`
→ `AwtsmoosMovie schema + validator`
→ `MovieCompiler`
→ `MovieTimeline + MovieSceneClock`
→ `MovieAssetIntent`
→ existing Procedural Core generators
→ renderer adapter (`2D` or `3D`)
→ preview frame
→ app-specific timeline/editor state where needed
→ export adapter / Nesher-derived verified encoding path

`Awtsmoos UI recipe`
→ `UiNormalizer`
→ `UiDomRenderer`
→ named action registry
→ app session state
→ movie compiler/playback/export services

## Collision policy
1. Prefer new files in new namespaces.
2. Re-read any legacy file immediately before full rewrite.
3. Use hashes or write-if-hash semantics if a contested file must change.
4. Never overwrite another agent's uncommitted changes blindly.
5. Never reset or stash unrelated work.
6. If a parallel agent lands an equivalent shared implementation first, inspect and extend it instead of duplicating it.

The graph is provisional by design: revelation must follow real imports, not desire.
